description: Use this when the user asks what came out in the Argentine quiniela on a day: '¿qué salió hoy?', 'quiniela de hoy', 'cabezas de ayer', 'resultados de la quiniela', 'quiniela nacional/provincia hoy'. Returns the cabeza (the winning number in position 1) of every jurisdiction and turno for that day; draws not held yet are 'pending'. Pass jurisdiction only when the user names specific quinielas; otherwise the widget shows the five best-known (Ciudad, Provincia, Córdoba, Santa Fe, Entre Ríos). For all 20 numbers of a draw use get_results. When the host shows the result as a widget, the user already sees every number: do not repeat them in a table or list, answer in one or two sentences (what is still pending, or what stands out).

date.description: Draw day in Argentina: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "yesterday". Omit for the latest results.

jurisdiction.description: Only these jurisdictions, comma-separated keys or names (e.g. chaco or mendoza,neuquen). Omit for all.

name: get_cabezas
title: Cabezas de la quiniela
